name: Gas Tally
office_task: Match the refrigerant log for every cylinder and van to the gas charged and recovered on each job, and list what does not reconcile for the licence holder before the reporting date.
systems_of_record: Simpro (the job system that issues the job id and holds the refrigerant charged and recovered on each job, against the cylinder used)
the cylinder log (one line per cylinder per job, by van, as the technician weighed it on the van scale, keyed by the job id and the cylinder id)

emits.write: the refrigerant tally for the period, written where the licence holder opens it: the pair contract it ran under, the join key (job id and cylinder id), the master per field, and the counts reconciled, within tolerance, not reconciled, unaccounted for and corrected, published weekly and again ahead of the reporting date, the all-clear included
emits.readback: the report store returns a report_id, and reading that id back returns the contract id, the five counts and the published time; no id back means the run did not publish and the owner is told

emits.write: an exception on the job and cylinder naming the person who owns it: kg charged, kg recovered or refrigerant type that does not reconcile, with the cylinder log's value, the job's value and the master's value side by side; gas on a cylinder line with no job record; gas on a job with no cylinder line; a gap over the threshold in kg; too many lines not reconciled; or an accepted correction whose write returned no id
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the job id, the cylinder id, the reason, both values and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops
